001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Dates;
007
008import java.time.Instant;
009
010/**
011 * History log record Date Change, opCode 14, size 26.
012 *
013 * <br>
014 *
015 * 
016 * <table border='1'>
017 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
018 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>14</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
019 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Date Change"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
020 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_DATE_CHANGED"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
021 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByAndroid</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
022 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTidepool</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
023 * </table>
024 */
025@HistoryLogProps(
026    opCode = 14,
027    displayName = "Date Change",
028    internalName = "LID_DATE_CHANGED",
029    usedByAndroid = true,
030    usedByTidepool = true
031)
032public class DateChangeHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
033    
034    private long datePrior;
035    private long dateAfter;
036    private long rawRTCTime;
037    
038    public DateChangeHistoryLog() {}
039    
040    public DateChangeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long datePrior, long dateAfter, long rawRTCTime) {
041        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, datePrior, dateAfter, rawRTCTime);
042        this.pumpTimeSec = pumpTimeSec;
043        this.sequenceNum = sequenceNum;
044        this.datePrior = datePrior;
045        this.dateAfter = dateAfter;
046        this.rawRTCTime = rawRTCTime;
047        
048    }
049
050    public int typeId() {
051        return 14;
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * <table border="1">
056     * <caption>Parsed fields for DateChangeHistoryLog:</caption>
057     * <tr><td><code>datePrior</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>dateAfter</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>rawRTCTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
060     * </table>
061     */
062    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
063        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
064        this.cargo = raw;
065        parseBase(raw);
066        this.datePrior = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
067        this.dateAfter = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
068        this.rawRTCTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
069        
070    }
071
072    
073    /**
074     * <table border="1">
075     * <caption>Byte layout for DateChangeHistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
076     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
077     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
078     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
079     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
080     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
081     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
082     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
083     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
084     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
085     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>toUint32(datePrior) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
086     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>toUint32(datePrior) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
087     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>toUint32(datePrior) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
088     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>toUint32(datePrior) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
089     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>toUint32(dateAfter) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
090     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>toUint32(dateAfter) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
091     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>toUint32(dateAfter) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
092     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>toUint32(dateAfter) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
093     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>toUint32(rawRTCTime) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
094     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>toUint32(rawRTCTime) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
095     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>toUint32(rawRTCTime) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
096     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>toUint32(rawRTCTime) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
097     * </table>
098     */
099    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long datePrior, long dateAfter, long rawRTCTime) {
100        return Bytes.combine(
101            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(14, 0),
102            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
103            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
104            Bytes.toUint32(datePrior), 
105            Bytes.toUint32(dateAfter), 
106            Bytes.toUint32(rawRTCTime),
107            new byte[4]);
108    }
109    
110    public long getDatePrior() {
111        return datePrior;
112    }
113    public long getDateAfter() {
114        return dateAfter;
115    }
116    public long getRawRTCTime() {
117        return rawRTCTime;
118    }
119
120    public Instant getDatePriorInstant() {
121        return Dates.fromJan12008EpochDaysToDate(datePrior);
122    }
123
124    public Instant getDateAfterInstant() {
125        return Dates.fromJan12008EpochDaysToDate(dateAfter);
126    }
127}
